reason: The README clearly describes a Web GUI appearance plugin centered on themes, wallpapers, textures, regional styling controls, and a keyboard desktop pet, so themes-layout is the appropriate primary category.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供预设与自定义主题、壁纸、纸纹、分区样式调节及可交互桌宠。
summaries.en: Customizes the DeepSeek Harness Web interface with preset and configurable themes, wallpapers, paper textures, regional styling controls, and an interactive desktop pet.

capabilities: customizes the web interface appearance with preset themes and user-configurable colors
applies static or video wallpapers and paper-texture overlays
adjusts regional transparency and text contrast through interface styling
supports importing and cropping user-selected background images
provides a draggable and resizable keyboard desktop pet
persists theme and appearance settings through the plugin service
